lines.text: Cassie, it's Mom. Happy Fourth. The fireworks have the cat under the stove again.
I bought a cake. I know. I know it's silly. He'd be twenty-six today... Anyway. Call me back, sweetheart.
Cassie? It's Mom. I know it's late. A man called about Tommy's car. Arlo something. He says he still has it.
He said you'd come for it tonight. Out in Yermo? At two in the morning?
Bring me something of his. Anything. ...And be nice to the dogs. You know how you get with dogs.
